name: Indian Butter Chicken with Peas, Cilantro & Basmati Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are soft, add ginger, garlic, and spices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp garam masala
1 tbsp curry powder
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, cream, and more butter to the skillet, then stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
1 (8 fl oz) can tomato sauce
½ cup heavy whipping cream
4 tsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: While the chicken is cooking, wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the chicken is done, add cilantro and peas to the skillet, then stir to combine. Remove butter chicken from heat and set aside to cool, about 20 minutes.
When the rice is done, transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Set aside to cool, about 20 minutes.
Divide cooled rice and butter chicken between containers, cover, and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat in the oven or microwave and enjoy!
